name: Nursery School Diaries
source:
Life as a nursery school teacher can be tough, but it's a rewarding job. What kind of little shenanigans will you be facing? Interact with the kids, and you might just become closer to their respective guardians.

[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/nursery-school-diaries]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
幼儿园老师的生活可能很艰难，但这是一份有意义的工作。你会遇到什么样的小恶作剧？与孩子们互动，你可能会与他们各自的监护人更加亲近。

[来自[url=https://chanimk.itch.io/nursery-school-diaries]itch.io[/url]]
